items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] No, I don't know him. His wife is dead. [INTERVIEWEE] Maybe we can talk to her sometime.

ctx.x: What? He's dead. Grover's dead. Oh, yeah.
No, I don't know him. His wife is dead.
Maybe we can talk to her sometime. She played saxophone. I don't know if she plays in the most power. Oh, yeah, alto saxophone. Yes.
